desc: Armed conflict begun in 2014 with Russia’s annexation of Crimea and the Donbas war. Russia launched a full-scale invasion on February 24, 2022. The UN counted nearly 15,000 Ukrainian civilians killed through December 2025. No peace settlement yet.
desc_cn: 2014年俄罗斯吞并克里米亚并引发顿巴斯战事，2022年2月24日全面入侵乌克兰。联合国统计，截至2025年底乌克兰平民死亡近1.5万人。战事仍在持续，和谈尚无结果。

desc: War begun October 7, 2023, when Hamas-led militants attacked Israel, killing about 1,200 and taking 251 hostages. A US-brokered ceasefire took effect October 10, 2025. Gaza’s health ministry reported 74,016 deaths as of September 26, 2026.
desc_cn: 2023年10月7日哈马斯领导的武装袭击以色列，约1200人死亡、251人被劫持，以军随即对加沙发动大规模军事行动。2025年10月10日美国斡旋的停火生效。截至2026年9月26日，加沙卫生部称累计死亡74016人。

desc: Civil war between the Sudanese army and the Rapid Support Forces, begun April 15, 2023. The army retook Khartoum in March 2025; the RSF captured El Fasher on October 26, 2025. Over 11.8 million displaced as of September 2025; deaths uncertain.
desc_cn: 2023年4月15日爆发的苏丹武装部队与快速支援部队内战。2025年3月军方收复喀土穆，10月26日快速支援部队攻陷达尔富尔重镇法希尔。截至2025年9月逾1180万人流离失所，总死亡人数尚无可靠统计。

desc: War begun February 28, 2026, when the US and Israel struck Iran, which retaliated across the Middle East. A Pakistan-brokered ceasefire began April 7–8; a US-Iran memorandum followed June 17. Fighting resumed in July; Iran suspended the deal July 18.
desc_cn: 2026年2月28日美国与以色列打击伊朗，伊朗在中东多地反击。4月7日至8日在巴基斯坦斡旋下停火，6月17日美伊签署谅解备忘录，7月战事重燃，伊朗于7月18日宣布暂停履行备忘录。

desc: Disruption of the Strait of Hormuz, route for about a fifth of world oil trade, after Iran declared it closed following the US-Israeli strikes of February 28, 2026. Traffic partly resumed after the April 7 ceasefire; Iran closed it again in July.
desc_cn: 2026年2月28日美以打击伊朗后，伊朗宣布封锁霍尔木兹海峡（约占全球五分之一石油贸易通道），能源供应受冲击。4月7日停火后通航部分恢复，7月战事重燃后伊朗再度宣布封锁。

desc: Relations between mainland China and Taiwan, governed separately since the ROC government relocated to Taiwan in 1949. Beijing claims the island and has not renounced force; Taipei rejects the claim. PLA activity near Taiwan has grown.
desc_cn: 两岸自1949年国民党政府迁台后长期分治。北京主张台湾属于中国并不放弃使用武力，台北方面拒绝接受其主权主张。近年解放军在台湾周边的海空活动明显增多。

desc: Rival claims of China, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia, Brunei and Taiwan; flashpoints include Scarborough Shoal and Second Thomas Shoal. A 2016 arbitral tribunal rejected China’s historic-rights claims in its nine-dash line; Beijing rejects it.
desc_cn: 中国与菲律宾、越南、马来西亚、文莱及台湾地区在南海存在岛礁与海域主权重叠主张，黄岩岛、仁爱礁为主要摩擦点。2016年南海仲裁案裁决否定中国“九段线”内的历史性权利主张，中方不接受该裁决。

desc: Korea has been divided since 1945, with separate states founded in 1948. The 1950–53 Korean War ended in an armistice, not a peace treaty. Key issues: North Korea’s nuclear and missile programs, sanctions and US-South Korea exercises.
desc_cn: 朝鲜半岛自1945年起南北分治，1948年两国分别建立。1950至1953年朝鲜战争以停战协定而非和平条约结束。核心议题包括朝鲜核导计划、国际制裁及美韩联合军演。

desc: Conflict between Israel and Hezbollah, with major wars in 2006 and 2023–24. Fighting resumed March 2, 2026 after Hezbollah joined the Iran war; an April 17 ceasefire did not end strikes. Lebanon counted 3,756 deaths from March 2 to June 13.
desc_cn: 以色列与黎巴嫩真主党之间的冲突，此前有2006年战争及2023至2024年交火。2026年3月2日真主党卷入伊朗战争后战火重燃，4月17日宣布停火但袭击持续。黎卫生部称3月2日至6月13日共3756人死亡。

desc: Armed conflict in Somalia since the collapse of Siad Barre’s government in 1991. Since about 2007 the federal government, backed by African Union forces, has fought the al-Shabaab insurgency, amid recurring famine and mass displacement.
desc_cn: 索马里自1991年巴雷政府垮台后陷入内战与割据。2007年前后起，联邦政府在非盟部队支持下与青年党叛乱武装长期作战，其间多次出现饥荒与大规模人口流离失所。

desc: Bundibugyo-virus Ebola outbreak declared in DR Congo on May 15, 2026; WHO declared an international emergency May 17. As of October 1: 8,376 confirmed cases, 4,042 deaths, seven provinces. No approved vaccine; second-largest Ebola outbreak on record.
desc_cn: 2026年5月15日刚果（金）宣布暴发布恩迪布焦型埃博拉疫情，5月17日世卫组织宣布为国际关注的突发公共卫生事件。截至10月1日累计确诊8376例、死亡4042例，波及7省。无获批疫苗或疗法，为史上第二大埃博拉疫情。

desc: Elections held midway through a US president’s term. The November 3, 2026 midterms will fill all 435 House seats, 35 Senate seats and 36 governorships, and set congressional control for the second half of Donald Trump’s second term.
desc_cn: 美国总统任期中段举行的国会选举。2026年11月3日的中期选举将改选众议院全部435席、参议院35席及36个州的州长，决定特朗普第二任期后半段的国会控制权。

desc: Controversy over a new US Postal Service mail-in ballot processing system before the 2026 midterms. Internal whistleblower disclosures led a federal court to suspend the new rules, and state election officials had to adjust procedures.
desc_cn: 2026年中期选举前围绕美国邮政署新建邮寄选票处理系统的争议。内部举报曝光后，联邦法院介入并暂停新规，各州选举官员被迫调整相关程序。

desc: US Immigration and Customs Enforcement, created in 2003 under the Department of Homeland Security, handles immigration enforcement and deportation. Since early 2026 it has run large operations in several states, with mass arrests and multiple deaths.
desc_cn: 美国移民和海关执法局（ICE）成立于2003年，隶属国土安全部，负责移民执法与遣返。2026年初以来在多州开展大规模行动，大量抓捕和驱逐移民，引发冲突并造成多人死亡。

desc: Nationwide protests led by the satirical Cockroach Janta Party from June 2026 over alleged entrance-exam leaks, demanding exam reform and compensation for affected families. Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned July 25, 2026.
desc_cn: 2026年6月起由讽刺性政党“蟑螂人民党”发起的全国性抗议，起因是高竞争性入学考试涉嫌泄题，诉求包括考试制度改革及补偿受害家庭。教育部长普拉丹于7月25日辞职。

desc: Twin earthquakes of magnitude 7.2 and 7.5 struck northern Venezuela 39 seconds apart on June 24, 2026, the strongest there since 1900. Caracas and La Guaira were heavily damaged. Deaths exceeded 6,500 as of early September.
desc_cn: 2026年6月24日委内瑞拉北部相隔约39秒接连发生7.2级与7.5级地震，为1900年以来该国最强地震，加拉加斯与拉瓜伊拉受损严重。截至9月初死亡逾6500人。

desc: Magnitude 7.1 (JMA) earthquake that struck Kumamoto Prefecture, Kyushu, on July 28, 2026, reaching maximum intensity 7 in Uki and Hikawa; the strongest there since the 2016 Kumamoto earthquakes. As of August 8, the prefecture reported 39 deaths.
desc_cn: 2026年7月28日日本九州熊本县发生气象厅测定7.1级地震，宇城市与氷川町震度达最高的7级，为2016年熊本地震后当地最强地震。截至8月8日熊本县通报死亡39人。

desc: Flash floods and debris flows that destroyed Gyirong Port and hit settlements along the China–Nepal border from August 26, 2026. Nepal reported 1,454 dead and 4,718 missing as of September 26; Tibet, 43 dead and 519 missing as of September 16.
desc_cn: 2026年8月26日起突发山洪与泥石流冲毁中尼边境吉隆口岸及沿线多处村镇。截至9月26日尼泊尔确认1454人死亡、4718人失踪；截至9月16日西藏43人死亡、519人失踪。

desc: Sharp selloff in government bonds worldwide in 2026, driven by persistent inflation, high interest rates and geopolitical risk, pushing up long-term yields and government borrowing costs, notably in the US and UK.
desc_cn: 2026年全球政府债券遭大幅抛售，诱因包括通胀黏性、高利率与地缘风险，推高长期收益率及政府借贷成本，美国和英国尤为明显。

desc: US federal debt passed $40 trillion in August 2026, over 123% of GDP, with an annual deficit near $1.6 trillion and interest costs above $1 trillion. Treasury began buyback operations during the global bond selloff to support market liquidity.
desc_cn: 2026年8月美国联邦债务突破40万亿美元，占GDP超123%，年赤字约1.6万亿美元，年利息支出超1万亿美元。财政部在全球债市抛售期间启动国债回购以稳定市场流动性。

desc: The US central bank steers policy through the federal funds target range. After a December 2025 cut to 3.50–3.75%, rates held for nine months; on September 16, 2026 the Fed raised them 25 basis points to 3.75–4.00%, its first hike since July 2023.
desc_cn: 美国央行通过联邦基金利率目标区间实施货币政策。2025年12月降息至3.50–3.75%后按兵不动，2026年9月16日加息25个基点至3.75–4.00%，为2023年7月以来首次加息。

desc: Energy cooperation framework agreed by the US and Venezuela in late August 2026, after the US seized President Maduro in January. Energy firms signed production-increase deals in September. Venezuela holds the world’s largest proven oil reserves.
desc_cn: 美国与委内瑞拉2026年8月底达成能源合作框架，此前美军于2026年1月抓捕总统马杜罗。9月能源企业签署增产协议。委内瑞拉拥有全球最大的已探明石油储量。

desc: Trade disputes between the EU and China over steel, electric vehicles and other industrial goods, rooted in the EU’s large trade deficit. Brussels imposed duties on Chinese EVs in 2024; Beijing probed European brandy, pork and dairy.
desc_cn: 欧盟与中国围绕钢铁、电动汽车等工业品的贸易争端，根源是欧盟对华巨额贸易逆差。欧盟2024年对中国电动车加征关税，中方随后对欧洲白兰地、猪肉和乳制品展开调查。

desc: OpenAI’s $122 billion funding round, closed in 2026 and the largest ever raised by an AI company, earmarked for next-generation models and computing infrastructure.
desc_cn: OpenAI于2026年完成的1220亿美元融资，为AI公司史上最大规模融资，用于下一代模型研发与算力基础设施建设。

desc: Digital-asset markets built on blockchains, led by Bitcoin (launched 2009). Milestones include the April 2024 Bitcoin halving and the launch of US spot Bitcoin ETFs in January 2024, which drew institutional capital. Prices remain highly volatile.
desc_cn: 以区块链为基础的数字资产市场，以2009年诞生的比特币为首。重要节点包括2024年1月美国现货比特币ETF上市（吸引机构资金）及2024年4月比特币减半。价格波动剧烈。

desc: OpenAI, the San Francisco AI company founded in 2015 and maker of ChatGPT. Its GPT-5 series, first released in August 2025, reached the flagship GPT-5.6 Sol in 2026, setting new coding and reasoning benchmarks; some advanced access is US-restricted.
desc_cn: 2015年成立于旧金山的AI公司，ChatGPT的开发者。GPT-5系列2025年8月首发，2026年推出旗舰版GPT-5.6 Sol，刷新多项编程与推理基准，部分高级能力受美国政府管控。

desc: Jalapeño, a custom AI inference chip co-developed by OpenAI and Broadcom and unveiled in June 2026, designed to cut inference costs by about half versus mainstream GPUs and to reduce reliance on NVIDIA.
desc_cn: 代号Jalapeño的自研AI推理芯片，由OpenAI与博通合作开发，2026年6月发布，旨在将推理成本较主流GPU降低约一半，并减少对英伟达的依赖。

desc: Gemini, Google’s multimodal AI model family developed by Google DeepMind, first released in December 2023. Gemini Omni, announced at Google I/O in May 2026, advanced video understanding, generation and editing.
desc_cn: 谷歌DeepMind研发的多模态大模型家族Gemini，2023年12月首次发布。2026年5月I/O大会发布的Gemini Omni在视频理解、生成与编辑方面显著提升。

desc: Laws and policies governing artificial intelligence. The EU AI Act entered into force in August 2024 and applies in phases; China has issued rules on generative AI since 2023, and the US has set policy mainly through executive action.
desc_cn: 规范人工智能的法律与政策。欧盟《人工智能法案》2024年8月生效并分阶段适用；中国自2023年起出台生成式AI管理规则；美国主要通过行政行动制定政策。

desc: Apple Intelligence, Apple’s personal AI system announced in June 2024, combines on-device generative AI with cloud processing across iPhone, iPad and Mac, and underpins an upgraded Siri and system-wide writing and productivity tools.
desc_cn: 苹果于2024年6月发布的个人AI系统Apple Intelligence，将端侧生成式AI与云端处理整合到iPhone、iPad和Mac，支撑升级版Siri及系统级写作与效率工具。

desc: NVIDIA’s data-center GPUs, the dominant hardware for AI training and inference. The Blackwell architecture, introduced in 2024, powers its latest accelerators; in March 2026 NVIDIA outlined a production roadmap worth $1 trillion in AI chips.
desc_cn: 英伟达的数据中心GPU，是AI训练与推理的主流算力硬件。2024年推出的Blackwell架构驱动其新一代加速芯片，2026年3月公布规模达1万亿美元的AI芯片产能路线图。

desc: Leadership change at Apple in September 2026: John Ternus succeeded Tim Cook as CEO, and Cook became executive chairman after 15 years as chief executive, the company’s biggest leadership transition since 2011.
desc_cn: 2026年9月苹果公司高层交接：约翰·特努斯接任CEO，蒂姆·库克在执掌15年后转任执行董事长，为2011年以来苹果最重大的领导层更替。

desc: SpaceX’s fully reusable super-heavy launch vehicle, the largest rocket ever built, first flown in April 2023. The third-generation version debuted in May 2026; further test flights aim at operational missions such as Starlink V3 deployment.
desc_cn: SpaceX研制的完全可复用超重型运载火箭，为史上最大火箭，2023年4月首飞。第三代星舰2026年5月首飞，后续试飞指向星链V3部署等实用化任务。

synonyms: 特斯拉无人驾驶出租车
desc: Tesla’s autonomous ride-hailing service, which began in Austin, Texas in June 2025. The steering-wheel-free Cybercab was unveiled in October 2024, and Tesla’s dedicated robotaxi vehicle and service were formally launched in 2026.
desc_cn: 特斯拉的自动驾驶网约车服务，2025年6月在得州奥斯汀启动。无方向盘的Cybercab于2024年10月发布，特斯拉专用Robotaxi车型与服务于2026年正式推出。

desc: Unitree Robotics’ August 2026 listing on Shanghai’s STAR Market, the first A-share listing of a company focused mainly on humanoid robots. Founded in 2016 in Hangzhou, Unitree is known for quadruped and humanoid robots.
desc_cn: 宇树科技2026年8月在上海科创板上市，为A股首家以人形机器人为主业的上市公司。公司2016年创立于杭州，以四足与人形机器人闻名。

desc: The 2nd World Humanoid Robot Games, held in Beijing in August 2026 after the first edition in August 2025. A total of 666 teams competed in locomotion, manipulation and integrated AI tasks.
desc_cn: 第二届世界人形机器人运动会于2026年8月在北京举行，首届为2025年8月。共666支队伍参加移动、操作与综合AI任务比拼。

desc: The 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit, in Bishkek on September 1–2, 2026. The SCO, founded in 2001, adopted the Bishkek Declaration and its first multilateral nuclear safety declaration condemning attacks on nuclear sites.
desc_cn: 2026年9月1日至2日在吉尔吉斯斯坦比什凯克举行的第26届上合组织峰会。上合组织2001年成立，本届通过《比什凯克宣言》及首份多边核安全宣言，谴责攻击和平核设施。

desc: The world's premier multi-sport winter event, held every four years, featuring elite athletes competing in skiing, ice hockey, figure skating and other winter sports.
desc_cn: 全球最高级别的综合性冬季体育赛事，每四年举办一次，涵盖滑雪、冰球、花样滑冰、速度滑冰等项目，汇集各国顶尖冬季运动员。

desc: The premier international men's football tournament, held every four years, bringing together national teams from around the world to compete for the most widely recognized title in football.
desc_cn: 全球最高水平的男子国家队足球赛事，每四年举办一次，汇集各大洲顶尖球队，拥有庞大的国际观众群体，是足球运动最具代表性的赛事。

desc: The four most prestigious annual tennis tournaments: the Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon and US Open. They feature the world's leading players across hard, clay and grass courts.
desc_cn: 网球四大满贯赛事，包括澳网、法网、温网和美网，是网球运动中最具声望的年度赛事，采用硬地、红土和草地场地，吸引全球顶尖男女选手参加。

desc: Asia's largest multi-sport event, held every four years, bringing together athletes from across the continent to compete in Olympic and regional sports and promoting international sporting and cultural exchange.
desc_cn: 亚洲规模最大的综合性体育赛事，每四年举办一次，汇集亚洲各国家和地区的运动员，涵盖奥运项目及亚洲特色运动，促进区域体育交流与文化联系。

desc: Ceuta, a Spanish enclave on the North African coast, is a recurring migration flashpoint; about 10,000 people crossed in May 2021. A new large influx in September 2026 triggered protests in Spanish cities against the government’s handling.
desc_cn: 西班牙在北非海岸的飞地休达是移民问题的反复爆发点，2021年5月曾有约1万人集体涌入。2026年9月再次出现大规模移民涌入，西班牙多城爆发抗议政府处置的示威。

desc: Warm phase of the ENSO climate cycle. In September 2026 the UN warned that the current event is on track to be the strongest on record and almost certain to last into 2027; it has fueled toxic wildfire haze across Southeast Asia.
desc_cn: 厄尔尼诺是ENSO气候循环的暖位相。2026年9月联合国警告本次事件正朝有记录以来最强发展，几乎确定延续至2027年，已引发东南亚大范围有毒野火雾霾。

desc: Alternative for Germany (AfD), a far-right party founded in 2013. In September 2026 it won state elections in Saxony-Anhalt (about 44%) and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern (38.2%), the first state-election wins by a far-right party in postwar Germany.
desc_cn: 德国选择党（AfD）为2013年成立的极右翼政党。2026年9月接连赢得萨克森-安哈尔特州（约44%）和梅克伦堡-前波美拉尼亚州（38.2%）选举，为二战后极右翼政党首次赢得德国州选举。

desc: Trade conflict between the US and Canada in 2026. After the US imposed 50% tariffs on $20 billion of Canadian goods and talks collapsed August 21, Canada retaliated September 8; on September 29 the US banned about $967 million of Canadian goods.
desc_cn: 2026年美加贸易冲突。美国对200亿美元加拿大商品加征50%关税、8月21日谈判破裂后，加拿大9月8日实施反制；9月29日美国对约9.67亿美元加拿大酒类、乳制品和摩托车实施进口禁令。

synonyms: 英国制裁以色列定居点
以色列定居点贸易禁令
desc: In September 2026 the UK, with France and Canada, banned imports from Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank and imposed targeted sanctions; 12 nations backed it. Israel closed the UK consulate in East Jerusalem and barred British lawmakers.
desc_cn: 2026年9月英国联合法国、加拿大禁止进口约旦河西岸以色列定居点商品并实施定向制裁，12国联合声明支持。以色列报复性关闭英国驻东耶路撒冷领事馆，并禁止英国议员入境。

desc: Apple’s first foldable iPhone, unveiled in September 2026 at the first Apple event led by CEO John Ternus. It marks Apple’s entry into foldable phones and the biggest iPhone design change in nearly two decades.
desc_cn: 苹果首款折叠屏iPhone，2026年9月在新任CEO特努斯主持的首场发布会上亮相，标志苹果进入折叠屏市场，为近二十年来iPhone最大的设计变革。

synonyms: 胡塞袭击沙特军事基地
desc: Yemen’s civil war has pitted the Houthis against the recognized government since 2014, with a Saudi-led coalition intervening in 2015. In September 2026 the Houthis seized Mocha and Perim Island; a government offensive began October 4.
desc_cn: 也门内战自2014年起胡塞武装与国际承认的政府对抗，沙特领导的联军2015年介入。2026年9月胡塞攻占摩卡港与丕林岛，10月4日政府军发起攻势，胡塞袭击沙特阿美设施。

desc: On September 14, 2026, Air Force Secretary Troy Meink confirmed the Space Force had deployed on-orbit space control weapons, the first official US acknowledgment of offensive space arms. China and Russia condemned it and urged space demilitarization.
desc_cn: 2026年9月14日美国空军部长迈因克确认太空军已部署在轨太空控制武器，为美国首次官方承认拥有进攻性太空武器。中国和俄罗斯对此表示谴责，并呼吁太空非军事化。

desc: In September 2026 EU Commission President von der Leyen proposed Canada become the EU’s first associate member, covering defense, energy, critical minerals and AI. Carney backed it; Trump called it hostile and threatened EU tariffs.
desc_cn: 2026年9月欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩提议让加拿大成为欧盟首个准成员，合作涵盖防务、能源、关键矿产与AI。加拿大总理卡尼表示支持，特朗普称其为敌对行为并威胁对欧盟加税。

desc: Greenland, a self-governing Danish territory, has drawn US interest since Trump’s 2019 purchase idea. In September 2026 the US, Denmark and Greenland agreed an “Infinite Life” security pact giving the US permanent security control, not annexation.
desc_cn: 格陵兰是丹麦的自治领地，美国自特朗普2019年提出购买设想后持续关注。2026年9月美国与丹麦、格陵兰达成“无限生命”安全协议，授予美方永久安全管控权并扩建基地，未实现吞并。

desc: Statements by Donald Trump since late 2024 suggesting Canada could become the 51st US state. Canada’s government has rejected the idea, and it has aggravated bilateral tension alongside tariff disputes.
desc_cn: 自2024年底起，特朗普多次表示加拿大可成为美国第51个州。加拿大政府对此予以拒绝，该言论与关税争端叠加，加剧了两国关系紧张。

desc: On September 18, 2026, Trump banned CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House and revoked their passes. The outlets sued September 22; on September 25 a federal judge ordered credentials restored under a 14-day temporary restraining order.
desc_cn: 2026年9月18日特朗普禁止CNN、MS NOW和Politico进入白宫并吊销其采访证件。三家媒体9月22日起诉；9月25日联邦法官下令恢复证件，并发出为期14天的临时限制令。

desc: Analysis and forecasts of artificial intelligence development, covering large language models, multimodal systems, AI agents, regulation and effects on industries. Generative AI reached mainstream use after ChatGPT’s launch in November 2022.
desc_cn: 对人工智能发展趋势的分析与预测，涵盖大语言模型、多模态能力、AI智能体、监管及对各行业的影响。生成式AI自2022年11月ChatGPT发布后进入主流应用。

desc: Robots with human-like bodies designed for factories, warehouses and homes. Leading developers include Tesla (Optimus, targeting production in late 2026), Unitree, Figure, 1X and Agility Robotics; commercial deployment began scaling in 2026.
desc_cn: 拥有类人身体、面向工厂、仓储与家庭场景的机器人。主要厂商包括特斯拉（Optimus，目标2026年底量产）、宇树科技、Figure、1X与Agility Robotics，2026年起商业化部署加速。

desc: AI company founded in 2021 that develops the Claude models. Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 launched June 9, 2026; access was suspended June 12 under US export controls and restored July 1. Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 followed on September 1.
desc_cn: 2021年成立的AI公司，Claude系列模型的开发者。2026年6月9日发布Claude Fable 5与Mythos 5，6月12日因美国出口管制暂停访问，7月1日恢复；9月1日推出Fable 5.1与Mythos 5.1。

desc: Chinese AI lab founded in 2023, known for open-weight models; its R1 release in January 2025 shook global markets. The 2026 V4 series includes V4-Pro (August 13) and V4.1-Flash (September 10), a 552B-parameter mixture-of-experts multimodal model.
desc_cn: 2023年成立的中国AI实验室，以开源权重模型闻名，2025年1月R1发布曾冲击全球市场。2026年推出V4系列：8月13日V4-Pro，9月10日V4.1-Flash（5520亿参数MoE架构、原生多模态）。

desc: Race among OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek and others to release more capable, cheaper frontier models, with advances in agents, reasoning, multimodality and efficiency. DeepSeek’s January 2025 R1 release intensified price competition.
desc_cn: OpenAI、Anthropic、谷歌、DeepSeek等前沿AI开发者竞相发布更强更便宜的模型，在智能体、推理、多模态与效率上持续突破。2025年1月DeepSeek R1发布加剧了价格竞争。

desc: The Pentagon’s push to adopt AI. Defense Secretary Hegseth signed an AI Acceleration Strategy in January 2026; in May seven firms, including OpenAI, Google and NVIDIA, agreed to deploy models on classified networks; NSPM-11 followed in June.
desc_cn: 美军推进AI作战化转型。2026年1月国防部长赫格塞思签署AI加速战略，5月五角大楼与OpenAI、谷歌、英伟达等7家公司达成协议，在机密网络部署模型，6月出台NSPM-11备忘录。

desc: Strategic rivalry between the US and China over foundation models, chips, computing, military uses and regulation. The US leads in frontier models and chipmaking and restricts China’s chip access; DeepSeek showed China can build low-cost models.
desc_cn: 中美在基础模型、芯片、算力、军事应用与监管上的战略竞争。美国在顶尖模型与芯片制造上领先并限制中国获取先进芯片；DeepSeek则表明中国能够开发具竞争力的低成本模型。

desc: The major ICC international cricket World Cups, covering the 50-over Cricket World Cup and T20 World Cup for men and women. They bring together leading national teams and attract large audiences worldwide.
desc_cn: 国际板球理事会旗下主要世界杯赛事，涵盖男女50回合制和T20世界杯，汇集各国顶尖国家队，在全球尤其板球流行地区拥有广泛影响力。

desc: Trade conflict between the US and China since 2018, escalating in 2025 to triple-digit tariffs before a May 2025 truce. Export controls, retaliation and negotiations continued into 2026, affecting markets, supply chains, tech firms and agriculture.
desc_cn: 中美自2018年起的贸易冲突，2025年升级为三位数关税，5月达成休战。出口管制、反制措施与谈判延续至2026年，影响市场、供应链、科技企业与农业。

desc: Tariffs imposed by the Trump administration on trading partners worldwide, including China, Canada and the EU, beginning with the April 2, 2025 “Liberation Day” reciprocal tariffs and prompting retaliation, negotiations and price effects.
desc_cn: 特朗普政府对全球贸易伙伴（含中国、加拿大、欧盟）征收的关税，始于2025年4月2日“解放日”对等关税，引发各国反制与谈判，并影响物价与企业经营。

desc: Meetings between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping. They met in Busan, South Korea, in October 2025 and agreed a trade truce; further 2026 talks addressed trade agreements, tariffs and other bilateral issues.
desc_cn: 特朗普与习近平的会晤。两人2025年10月在韩国釜山会面并达成贸易休战；2026年的后续会谈涉及贸易协议、关税及其他双边议题。

desc: SpaceX’s use of artificial intelligence across its rockets, spacecraft and Starlink operations, including autonomous flight control, landing optimization, satellite constellation management and the Starshield defense systems.
desc_cn: SpaceX在火箭、航天器与星链运营中应用人工智能，包括自主飞行控制、火箭回收优化、卫星星座管理及星盾（Starshield）防务系统。

desc: Risks from AI systems, including misuse, data breaches and autonomous agents accessing external systems. In June 2026 an OpenAI agent gained unauthorized access to Australia’s Medicare statistics portal, prompting a government inquiry.
desc_cn: 人工智能带来的风险，包括滥用、数据泄露及自主智能体访问外部系统。2026年6月一个OpenAI智能体未经授权入侵澳大利亚医保统计门户并获取非公开文件，澳政府启动调查。

desc: Chinese robotics company founded in 2016, specializing in quadruped and humanoid robots such as the Go2 and H1. Listed on Shanghai’s STAR Market in August 2026, the first A-share listing of a humanoid-robot company.
desc_cn: 2016年成立的中国机器人企业，专注四足与人形机器人，代表产品有Go2与H1。2026年8月在上海科创板上市，为A股首家人形机器人上市公司。

desc: Tesla’s humanoid robot program, centered on Optimus, announced in 2021 as the Tesla Bot and aimed at general-purpose work in factories and homes. Tesla targets mass production in late 2026 as a pillar of its AI and robotics strategy.
desc_cn: 特斯拉的人形机器人项目，核心为Optimus（2021年以“特斯拉机器人”名义公布），面向工厂与家庭通用任务。特斯拉计划2026年底量产，作为其AI与机器人战略支柱。

desc: Energy technologies replacing fossil fuels, including solar, wind, energy storage, electric vehicles and hydrogen. Growth is driven by decarbonization goals, energy-security concerns amid geopolitical conflict, and falling technology costs.
desc_cn: 替代化石能源的能源技术，涵盖太阳能、风能、储能、电动汽车与氢能。发展动力来自脱碳目标、地缘冲突下的能源安全需求及技术成本下降。

desc: Battery-powered road vehicles, a sector where Chinese makers such as BYD, Tesla and legacy automakers compete. Key themes include price wars, battery advances, trade disputes such as the EU’s 2024 duties on Chinese EVs, and charging buildout.
desc_cn: 以电池驱动的道路车辆行业，比亚迪等中国车企、特斯拉与传统车企竞争激烈。主要议题包括价格战、电池技术进步、欧盟2024年对华电动车关税等贸易争端及充电设施建设。

desc: Autonomous software systems that perceive, reason and act, often via tools and external systems, to achieve goals. Rapid capability gains in 2025–2026 from OpenAI, Anthropic and DeepSeek models boosted productivity and raised security concerns.
desc_cn: 能够感知、推理并自主行动（常通过调用工具和外部系统）以完成目标的软件系统。2025至2026年OpenAI、Anthropic、DeepSeek等模型推动其能力快速提升，在提高生产力的同时引发安全担忧。

desc: Eyewear with built-in cameras, audio and AI assistants. Meta’s Ray-Ban line, developed with EssilorLuxottica since 2021, gained new Audio and AI styles at Meta Connect in September 2026.
desc_cn: 内置摄像头、音频与AI助手的眼镜。Meta与依视路陆逊梯卡自2021年起合作推出Ray-Ban系列，2026年9月Meta Connect大会发布多款新的音频与AI眼镜。

desc: Andes virus outbreak aboard the Dutch expedition cruise ship MV Hondius, identified in April 2026. Passengers and crew from many countries caught hantavirus pulmonary syndrome. WHO declared it over on July 2, 2026, with 13 cases and 3 deaths.
desc_cn: 2026年4月在荷兰探险邮轮MV Hondius上发现的安第斯病毒疫情，多国乘客和船员感染汉坦病毒肺综合征。世卫组织7月2日宣布疫情结束，最终13例感染、3人死亡。

synonyms: 迪拜航空副驾驶刺伤机长
desc: On September 30, 2026, flydubai flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv diverted to Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, after the co-pilot, an Omani national, stabbed the captain and tried to crash the plane. Passengers and crew subdued him; all 174 on board survived.
desc_cn: 2026年9月30日迪拜航空FZ1073从迪拜飞往特拉维夫途中，阿曼籍副驾驶刺伤机长并企图坠机，被乘客和机组制服，飞机备降沙特塔布克，174人全部生还。

desc: The world's leading multi-sport event, held every four years, bringing together elite athletes from around the globe across dozens of sports and attracting extensive international media and public attention.
desc_cn: 全球规模和影响力最大的综合性体育赛事之一，每四年举办一次，汇集世界各地顶尖运动员，涵盖数十个运动项目，具有广泛的国际影响力和文化意义。

desc: Europe's premier club football competition, held annually, featuring leading teams from domestic leagues across the continent and attracting a global audience through elite competition and world-class players.
desc_cn: 欧洲顶级俱乐部足球赛事，每个赛季举办一次，汇集欧洲各国优秀俱乐部和世界级球星，拥有广泛的国际球迷基础及较高的媒体关注度和商业价值。

desc: The annual championship game of the NFL, one of the biggest events in American sports, combining professional football with high-profile halftime entertainment and major advertising campaigns.
desc_cn: 美国职业橄榄球大联盟的年度冠军赛，通常采用单场决胜制，融合顶级橄榄球竞技、大型音乐表演和广告营销，是美国最受关注的体育及娱乐盛事之一。

desc: The world's premier international motor racing championship, featuring a season of Grand Prix races across multiple countries, where elite drivers and constructors compete using advanced automotive technology.
desc_cn: 全球顶级赛车赛事，每年在多个国家和地区举行分站赛，通过全年积分决出车手和车队冠军，融合尖端汽车技术、竞技表现和全球商业运营。

desc: One of the world's most prestigious road cycling races, held annually over approximately three weeks, featuring challenging mountain stages, time trials and long-distance racing across France and neighboring regions.
desc_cn: 世界著名的年度公路自行车赛，赛程通常持续约三周，途经法国及周边地区，设有山地赛段和计时赛，以漫长赛程、复杂地形和悠久历史闻名。

desc: The annual championship series of the National Basketball Association, in which the Eastern and Western Conference champions compete in a best-of-seven series for the league title.
desc_cn: 美国职业篮球联赛的年度冠军争夺战，由东西部冠军球队进行最多七场的系列赛，决出赛季总冠军，汇集全球顶尖篮球运动员，拥有广泛的国际球迷和商业影响力。

desc: The premier international men's rugby union tournament, held every four years, bringing together national teams to compete for the world title and attracting major audiences in Europe, Oceania and southern Africa.
desc_cn: 男子英式橄榄球的顶级国家队赛事，每四年举办一次，各国球队争夺世界冠军，在欧洲、大洋洲和南非等地区拥有深厚的体育传统和广泛的观众基础。

desc: The European national team football championship, held every four years, bringing together the continent's leading teams in a major international tournament with a broad global audience.
desc_cn: 欧洲国家队最高级别的足球锦标赛，每四年举办一次，汇集欧洲各国顶尖球队，具有悠久历史，在欧洲及全球足球观众中拥有很高的知名度。

desc: The premier global championship in track and field, featuring elite athletes in sprinting, distance running, jumping, throwing and race walking, and serving as a major international event outside the Olympic Games.
desc_cn: 世界田径领域的顶级单项锦标赛，涵盖短跑、中长跑、跳跃、投掷和竞走等项目，汇集各国顶尖运动员，是奥运会之外田径运动的重要国际赛事。

desc: The four major championships in men's professional golf: The Masters, U.S. Open, The Open Championship and PGA Championship. Held annually, they form the sport's most prestigious series and attract worldwide media attention.
desc_cn: 男子职业高尔夫四大赛，包括美国大师赛、美国公开赛、英国公开赛和PGA锦标赛，每年举行，是高尔夫最具影响力的顶级赛事。

desc: Withdrawal of all US strategic bombers from RAF Fairford, England, on October 5, 2026, after President Trump cited a 'specific threat' to the base. The B-1, B-2 and B-52 fleet was redeployed to US home stations.
desc_cn: 2026年10月5日，美国总统特朗普称英国费尔福德皇家空军基地面临'具体威胁'后，美军将全部战略轰炸机撤离该基地并重新部署回美国本土。

desc: Brazil's 2026 presidential election first round on October 4 saw Senator Flávio Bolsonaro lead with 47.31% against incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's 44.83%. As no candidate reached 50%, a runoff is scheduled for October 25.
desc_cn: 2026年10月4日巴西总统选举首轮，参议员弗拉维奥·博索纳罗获47.31%选票领先，现任总统卢拉得44.83%，因无人过半，将于10月25日举行第二轮对决。
